newsitem.title: SUDAN: Three killed in riot in tribal western Sudan.
newsitem.headline: Three killed in riot in tribal western Sudan.

text.p: Three people were killed and many injured in a riot in western Sudan, the official news agency SUNA said on Monday.
The riot broke out in the middle of last week in the town of Geneina, the capital of Western Darfur state, after a gang attacked some villages in the state, it said.
The state legislature described it as a violation of a reconciliation agreement signed last November after fighting between the Massalit and and some Arab tribes.
Gang warfare and armed robbery are rampant in Western Darfur and other states in western Sudan.
